## az ad sp owner list

List service principal owners.

**Required parameters**

- `--id` — Service principal name, or object id or the service principal.

*List service principal owners. (autogenerated)*
```azurecli
az ad sp owner list --id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
